_meta.what: Curated registry for the Recipe Brain's web-import channel. Each entry is a recipe site with schema.org/Recipe markup that the existing importer can already parse.
_meta.law: EVERY site ships disabled. Enabling one is the OWNER'S decision, made after reading that site's terms and robots.txt — the channel additionally checks robots.txt at request time and fails closed (unreachable robots = site skipped). The app never sweeps a site the owner did not explicitly turn on.
_meta.conduct: Identified user-agent, one search-page fetch per site per request, at most maxImportsPerSite recipe pages, honest 'imported' provenance on every saved row. This is the same legal posture as the manual URL importer — the user choosing sources — made explicit and rate-limited.
_meta.shape: searchUrl uses {query} as the placeholder. linkPattern is a substring the site's recipe URLs contain (candidate filter, same-host only).
